scope.purpose: Separate reproduced failures from uncovered static defects using the final snapshot recorded in diagnostics_log.md.
scope.mutation_boundary: No application, SQL, test, provider, protected-system, or Git state was changed by this diagnostic report.

reproduced_failures.title: Generated evidence is stale
root_causes: deployment_manifest.json predates the six-flag contract and omits internal_review_enabled and student_content_enabled
rollback_manifest.json lists four flags instead of all six flags
artifact_checksums.json records 26 application files while the inspected non-evidence estate contains 43
twelve listed artifacts have stale bytes or hashes
seventeen current files are absent from the checksum manifest
test_results.json records five test files and 30 passed assertions while the final inspected run discovered 12 test files, passed 194 tests, and skipped one
generate_evidence.mjs selects the old 0001 migration pair and carries obsolete MissionMed OS blockers
reproduced_failures.observed_result: The validator returned 19 errors and exit code 1.
reproduced_failures.disposition: Repair generator inputs and regenerate the evidence estate before certification.

reproduced_failures.title: PostgreSQL execution proof did not run in the inspected snapshot
root_causes: I1Q_POSTGRES_TEST_URL was absent in the inspected Avicenna run
static SQL tests and a fake driver do not prove PostgreSQL execution semantics
reproduced_failures.observed_result: The executable apply, reapply, role attack, isolation, compensation, and forced-RLS proof was skipped.
reproduced_failures.disposition: Require a passing isolated disposable PostgreSQL run before database certification.

findings.title: Channel policy is not enforced in SQL
findings.root_cause: i1q.create_channel_artifact checks caller role, release existence, and active policy existence, but it does not bind the target channel to the policy channel, enforce field_rules, perform a closed-world field scan, reject answer or rationale fields in class A or pre_answer payloads, or require successful leak validation.
findings.risk: A future runtime grantee could store an arbitrary answer-bearing payload while labeling it class A and pre_answer.
findings.current_mitigation: No runtime function grant exists in the candidate.
findings.required_resolution: Enforce the channel security policy and leak contract inside the trusted SQL boundary, then add negative executable tests.

findings.title: Release validation does not require official checks
findings.root_cause: SQL and the in-memory application accept any nonempty caller-supplied check list. They do not require all official leak-test identifiers, require one result per artifact, or prove that the supplied evidence hash names stored results.
findings.risk: An independent actor and matching manifest hash can record a nominal pass without proving the required release checks ran.
findings.current_mitigation: Release and consumer paths remain disabled.
findings.required_resolution: Bind validation to the official check inventory, exact artifacts, and immutable stored evidence.

findings.title: Review assignment order and completion diverge
findings.root_cause: The SQL assignment function does not verify current workflow state or require specialty. The in-memory application also creates assignments without a workflow-state check and does not move an accepted assignment to completed after its review event.
findings.risk: Medical review can be assigned too early, and application assignment state can diverge from SQL behavior.
findings.current_mitigation: A later medical event is blocked until medical_review, but the assignment and completion defects remain.
findings.required_resolution: Enforce assignment ordering and specialty requirements, complete assignments atomically with events, and test parity across repositories.

findings.title: Lifecycle and immutability rules are internally inconsistent
findings.root_cause: The migration rejects all item revision updates, including draft edits, and exposes no draft-edit function. Review event destinations omit superseded and retired. Source records, privacy redaction records, and extraction runs are absent from the immutable trigger list despite the architecture declaring them immutable.
findings.risk: The authoring lifecycle cannot be represented faithfully and some required immutable history lacks table-level protection.
findings.current_mitigation: Deny-all write posture limits present reachability.
findings.required_resolution: Align draft editing, candidate immutability, retirement, supersession, and immutable trigger coverage with Architecture 1002.1.

findings.title: Expired rights can remain release eligible
findings.root_cause: rights_records.expires_at exists, but neither release assembly path checks it.
findings.risk: A rights record that still says cleared_for can remain eligible after its expiry timestamp.
findings.current_mitigation: No student or consumer release is enabled.
findings.required_resolution: Check rights currency directly during assembly or prove an independent fail-closed status transition process.

findings.title: Metadata RLS is broader than the binding RBAC sketch
findings.root_cause: A shared metadata policy grants authors and reviewers table-wide reads across releases, promotions, claims, model metadata, incidents, and psychometrics, while the architecture limits authors to their lineage and reviewers to assigned scope. The read_only role cannot read psychometric snapshots.
findings.risk: Future grants would expose more metadata than the binding role model allows and omit intended analytics access.
findings.current_mitigation: The migration grants no runtime role access.
findings.required_resolution: Replace shared broad policies with role-specific lineage, assignment, governance, and analytics policies.

findings.title: Compensation audit idempotence is not concurrency safe
findings.root_cause: The compensation function uses IF NOT EXISTS followed by an audit insert without a uniqueness constraint on compensation action plus entity ID. Concurrent calls can both pass the check. The function also lacks an internal actor or role check.
findings.risk: Concurrent compensation can append duplicate audit events, and safety depends entirely on withholding function execution grants.
findings.current_mitigation: The candidate revokes the compensation execution path from runtime roles.
findings.required_resolution: Add a database-enforced idempotency key and retain an explicit privileged-only execution boundary.

made: Converted the diagnostic root-cause report from Markdown to structured JSON only.
proposed: Repair findings AV-SF-001 through AV-SF-005 before any database apply.
Add regression coverage for all seven findings.
Resolve or explicitly accept AV-SF-006 and AV-SF-007 before granting a runtime role.
Regenerate evidence only after the generator reflects current authority, files, flags, migrations, and tests.

tests_performed.test: Final local application suite recorded by diagnostics_log.md
tests_performed.result: All executed tests passed; 194 passed and one PostgreSQL execution proof was skipped.
Failed closed with 19 errors and exit code 1 because generated evidence was stale.

risks: The migration pair is not apply-ready solely on the evidence in this diagnostic snapshot.
Static and fake-driver tests cannot prove PostgreSQL, RLS, transaction, or concurrency semantics.
No finding authorizes mutation of a protected system or production datastore.
blockers: Critical channel-payload enforcement is absent from SQL.
Official release checks are not database-bound.
Review workflow, lifecycle, rights currency, RLS scope, and compensation idempotence require resolution.
Generated evidence must be corrected and regenerated.

confidence.basis: Each finding is tied to inspected source lines and a binding architecture requirement. Runtime exploitability is not claimed while runtime grants remain absent.

handoff: Root should gate database application on repairs for AV-SF-001 through AV-SF-005, regression coverage for all seven findings, current regenerated evidence, and a passing disposable PostgreSQL run. AV-SF-006 and AV-SF-007 require resolution or explicit authority acceptance before a runtime role is granted.
